title: Ultimate
tagline: One Android app that holds a growing set of small offline tools, with no ads, no accounts and no internet permission.
stateNote: Described in the README. I haven't built or run the Android app.
problem: Utilities are often bloated with ads and trackers. Ultimate bundles small tools such as a video editor and a video shrinker, and its manifest has no INTERNET permission.
audience: Android users who want simple offline tools.
contribution: It is my project and consolidates earlier standalone Android tools.
worksToday: The README lists tools including Studio (an offline video editor) and Squeeze (video shrinking).
limitations: I haven't built or installed it.
Claims here come from the README.

involve.headline: Which tool is missing?
asks: Tell me which small offline tool you wish existed.
